text: The minutes piece will be captured and placed in the shared folder by the end of the session (Item 0).
A questionnaire will be completed after lunch (Item 1).
There is a conflict between management's teletext obsolescence claim and questionnaire data showing teletext usage (Item 2).
Ambiguity in audience segmentation (three versus two audiences) is affecting the marketing direction (Item 3).

A set of decisions establishes teletext as outdated with internet as the main focus, targets younger audiences, and prescribes a remote with advanced touchscreen options while restricting its use to television and avoiding a built-in receiver (Items 5–10).
